prompts.mobile:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent character illustration for the existing Jeongtong Saju reading page, square high-resolution composition.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute identity authority: the existing black-haired male guide holding an open black book. Input image 2 (King of Pentacles tarot card) is ONLY a rendering/material/style reference, NOT a face reference.
Primary request: repaint the existing guide with the polished, richly shaded illustrated tarot finish of image 2, while keeping image 1's face unmistakably unchanged. Preserve exactly his face shape and jaw, eye spacing and amber-brown eyes, eyebrow shape, nose, lips and friendly restrained expression; preserve the same tousled dark hair silhouette, hair part, silver ear jewelry, age and body proportions. Keep both eyes visibly open looking towards the reader. Do not substitute the tarot king's face. The user insists that the established face MUST remain the same.
Pose/composition: a calm scholar presenting an open antique book at chest level, essentially the current pose. Show the full width of both shoulders and sleeves with comfortable clear space, head fully inside canvas; waist-up, no shoulder crop. The book covers most of the lower hands; exactly two arms and two anatomically natural hands lightly supporting the book, no pointing, no pinching gesture.
Clothing: an elegant deep forest-green outer robe over warm ivory and charcoal layers, fine restrained gold embroidery and a small gold clasp, with naturally weighted woven fabric and detailed seams. No crown, no armor, no new face accessories. The antique book has restrained gold botanical/geometric tooling with five small muted colored page ribbons, no legible writing or diagrams claiming to be real chart data.
Rendering: exceptionally crisp refined fine linework, dimensional yet elegant anime-fantasy painting, subtly translucent skin shading, fine individual hair locks, tactile silk and linen, controlled gold highlights, soft daylight from upper left. Match the premium illustrated tarot craftsmanship, not photographic skin or a 3D render. Preserve the original face's identity over every stylistic change.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha around the complete character and book; no room, backdrop, painted halo, checkerboard, card frame, text, number, title or watermark. This is a reusable page illustration, not a tarot card. Deliver one sharp high-resolution square PNG. Identity preservation is the highest priority.
prompts.desktop:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset type: wide 16:9 background illustration for the left and right sides of a desktop reading page.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and composition/identity authority: the existing golden library with the male guide standing at far left holding a book and the female guide seated at far right. Input image 2 (King of Pentacles tarot) is ONLY a fine painting/material/style reference.
Primary request: produce a new polished tarot-painted edition of this library background. Preserve BOTH existing people's exact facial identities from image 1: facial contours, eyes, eyebrows, noses, lips, hairlines, hairstyles, ages and expressions. Keep the man recognizably the same man and the woman recognizably the same woman. Do not redesign faces or borrow a different face from image 2. Their eyes remain open, composed, attentive. Face identity is non-negotiable.
Composition: retain the wide library scene, man on the far left and woman on the far right, similar full-body scale and distance, spacious quiet center. Neither person nor an important object may enter the central 46% of the frame because a reading column covers it. Preserve both complete heads and shoulders and ample breathing space. Keep the library, antique books, shelves, tall windows and naturally coherent architectural perspective. The characters remain at the outer edges, not close-up portraits.
Scene: the same two learned guides in a sunlit classical library. The man studies the existing open antique volume, the woman rests her hands naturally on a closed volume at her seat; exactly two arms per person, books support/obscure complicated fingers. Keep their forest green/ivory and burgundy/ivory costumes, refine stitched gold embroidery and fabric folds rather than adding jewelry. Keep original vivid yet balanced color, clear warm daylight and blue distant mountains. Make the central architecture calmer and less ornamentally busy; preserve spatial depth, no opaque blank panel painted into the scene.
Style: the refined illustrated tarot finish from image 2—precise flowing linework, dimensional faces, luminous restrained highlights, richly tactile cloth and old leather, believable metal glints, finely drawn but controlled architectural details. A coherent hand-painted fantasy illustration, not photorealism, not 3D, not watercolor haze. No added people, no extra limbs, no modern gadgets.
Deliver one sharp high-resolution landscape 16:9 illustration, preferably 3072x1728 or higher if supported. Opaque background. No card borders, no number, no caption, no watermark. Keep the original face identities and the established far-away character composition above all.
